title: Search Results Page
content: Build search results page. Header: search input with query shown, result count. Filters sidebar: checkboxes for categories, price range slider, rating filter. Sort dropdown: relevance, price, date. Results grid or list view toggle. Result cards: image, title, description, metadata. Pagination: numbered pages or infinite scroll. No results state. Related searches.

variants.advanced: Build comprehensive search results page with filtering and sorting. Page header: search input (pre-filled with query, editable), "X results for [query]" count. Layout: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-8. Filters sidebar (lg:col-span-1): sticky top-4, bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-4. "Filters" header with "Clear All" link. Filter groups as collapsible sections: Category (checkbox list with counts), Price Range (dual-handle slider or min/max inputs), Rating (star rating checkboxes), Date (date range picker or presets), Brand (searchable checkbox list if many). "Apply Filters" button (mobile), filters apply instantly (desktop). Active filters: pills above results showing active filters with X to remove. Mobile: filters in sheet/modal triggered by "Filters" button, badge with active count. Results area (lg:col-span-3): header bar: sort dropdown (Relevance, Price: Low to High, Price: High to Low, Newest, Best Rating), view toggle (Grid/List icons). Grid view: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-4. List view: space-y-4, horizontal card layout. Result card: image (aspect-square or aspect-video), title (font-medium line-clamp-2), description (text-sm text-gray-600 line-clamp-2), metadata (price, rating stars, date, location), quick action (Add to Cart, Save). Hover: shadow-md, reveal additional actions. Highlighting: search term highlighted in title/description (mark tag or bg-yellow-200). Pagination: flex justify-center mt-8, "Previous" / page numbers / "Next", or infinite scroll with "Load More" button. Results per page selector. Loading: skeleton cards during fetch. No results: friendly message "No results found for [query]", suggestions (check spelling, try different keywords, browse categories), "Clear filters" if filters active. Related searches: "People also search for" with clickable terms. Did you mean: spelling correction suggestion. Search history: recent searches dropdown in search input. Mobile: collapse filters, 2-column grid. Accessibility: filter changes announced, results count updated, pagination navigable.
